title: Source-identified engineering creep-fatigue assessment
purpose: Verify a standard-neutral engineering contract that combines direct or named-history-derived reviewed rupture-time blocks with an existing fatigue assessment through an explicit interaction boundary.
physics: Postprocessed creep time-fraction and stress-life fatigue damage

execution.evidence: Unit tests cover time fractions, source retention, named stress/temperature history windows, endpoint interpolation, out-of-range failure, interaction interpolation, decisions, public discovery and structured SimulationResult attachment.

observables: Creep damage by service block and total time fraction
Fatigue damage from the existing rainflow and S-N consumer
Allowable fatigue damage at the computed creep damage
Interaction margin, decision and complete source records
Per-dwell governing stress, temperature, physical interval and rupture relation source
acceptance: Every rupture-time block declares a nonempty source.
Interaction points are finite, bounded, strictly increasing in creep damage and strictly decreasing in allowable fatigue damage.
No normative or material-specific interaction points are silently supplied by AgentFEM.
A dwell outside either named history is rejected rather than clamped.
The complete assessment is JSON-safe and can be attached to a SimulationResult.
limitations: This postprocessor does not solve cyclic plasticity, dwell relaxation or coupled constitutive damage.
Project qualification remains responsible for rupture relations, fatigue curves and interaction data.
